sample-1971-1: When workers fear that reporting a wage theft or a safety violation will end with an immigration hold, employers who cheat gain an advantage over employers who follow the law. This bill protects honest Maine businesses as much as it protects workers.
sample-1971-2: I served twenty-six years in county law enforcement. Cooperation between agencies is how small departments function. Micromanaging from Augusta which calls a deputy can return will create hesitation in situations where hesitation gets people hurt.
sample-1971-3: Maine agriculture runs on a workforce that is aging at home and arriving from abroad. Our members need workers who are not afraid to drive to the farm. Clarifying that local police are not federal immigration agents keeps our harvest crews stable and our rural communities functioning.
sample-1971-4: Living on the border my whole life, I see both sides of this. Federal cooperation matters here in ways southern Maine doesn't always understand. I'd ask the committee to add a border-county consultation requirement before finalizing the rules.
